title: Game Map Viewer — registry.json
description: Lists the games available to the viewer. Lives at public/games/registry.json. See CONTRACT.md.

id.description: Game identifier; must match the `id` inside the referenced game.json.

configPath.description: Absolute server path to the game's config, e.g. /res/metal_max/game.json.

name.description: Localized game name (same shape as game.json `name`). Lets the game picker label every game without fetching each game.json up front.

exportedAt.description: ISO timestamp of this game's latest export — lets one registry fetch show every game's data freshness.
